purpose: Deterministically derive current state for an ORIGINAL_ACCEPTED_TERMS_CONTINUATION obligation from authentic append-only lifecycle observations and resolution receipts without destroying history or treating receipt order as validity.
validation_order: bind exact continuing_obligation_id, successor_obligation_id, source closure/engagement/proposal/version and ORIGINAL_ACCEPTED_TERMS_CONTINUATION classification
validate each observation/receipt independently for authentic evidence, required actor attribution/authority, obligation scope and state-specific predicates
validate predecessor references and allowed transition semantics; timestamps cannot repair a broken predecessor link
deduplicate only byte/evidence-identical or explicitly same-event records; retain all source records
construct the unique valid predecessor-linked history graph
derive current state only when one unambiguous valid frontier exists; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED

precedence.rule: Semantic validity and authenticated predecessor lineage take precedence over timestamp, insertion order, repository order, identifier lexical order or receipt arrival order.
precedence.terminal: A valid SATISFIED or WAIVED receipt is terminal for ordinary lifecycle projection unless a separately valid historical correction model is introduced; contradictory later ordinary observations do not override it and force FAIL_CLOSED.
precedence.unsatisfied: A valid BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt projects that state unless exactly one valid cure receipt descends from that exact unsatisfied receipt.
precedence.cure_satisfied: Valid CURE_SATISFIED descending from the projected BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt projects SATISFIED_AFTER_CURE.
precedence.cure_waived: Valid CURE_WAIVED descending from the projected BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt projects WAIVED_AFTER_UNSATISFIED.
precedence.fail_closed: Any unresolved authenticity, lineage, authority, contradiction or frontier ambiguity takes precedence over a substantive projected state.

state_derivation.PENDING_TRIGGER: Unique valid frontier is PENDING_TRIGGER and no authentic due trigger or terminal resolution exists.
state_derivation.DUE: Unique valid frontier is DUE with authentic trigger/time evidence and no later valid progress/resolution receipt.
state_derivation.IN_PROGRESS: Unique valid frontier is IN_PROGRESS with valid DUE predecessor, attributable progress evidence and required separate consequential-work authorization.
state_derivation.SATISFIED: Unique valid frontier is an immutable SATISFIED resolution receipt with valid predecessor/evidence/attribution.
state_derivation.WAIVED: Unique valid frontier is an immutable WAIVED resolution receipt with explicit authorized waiver evidence.
state_derivation.BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED: Unique valid frontier is an immutable BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt and no valid cure descendant exists.
state_derivation.SATISFIED_AFTER_CURE: Unique valid frontier is CURE_SATISFIED referencing the exact retained BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt and authentic cure evidence.
state_derivation.WAIVED_AFTER_UNSATISFIED: Unique valid frontier is CURE_WAIVED referencing the exact retained BREACHED_OR_UNSATISFIED receipt and authentic waiver evidence.
state_derivation.FAIL_CLOSED: No unique authentic valid frontier can be derived.

contradictory: two or more independently valid incompatible frontier states exist
SATISFIED and WAIVED receipts claim the same unresolved predecessor without an explicit valid relationship
terminal/cure receipt conflicts with exact obligation identity, source coordinates, scope or triggering evidence
duplicate: same event identifier has different content/evidence/authority
nominal duplicates cannot be proven to represent the same event
duplicate records create competing predecessor descendants
stale: observation references a predecessor that is not the unique valid frontier required by its transition
ordinary lifecycle observation attempts to continue after valid SATISFIED or WAIVED terminal receipt
cure references an unsatisfied receipt other than the exact retained predecessor lineage
unauthorized: required actor/waiver/accountable-owner authority is absent, unresolved or rejected
IN_PROGRESS lacks separately required consequential-work authorization
record attempts to derive authority from timestamp/order/repository presence alone
broken_lineage: predecessor state does not match referenced observation
source closure/engagement/proposal/version or obligation identifiers diverge across lineage
evidence: required evidence absent, contradictory, unauthenticated or cannot be bound to exact state predicate

duplicate_handling: Exact duplicate representations of the same authenticated event may collapse to one projection node only after identity/evidence equivalence is established; duplicates remain retained as source evidence. Non-identical duplicates FAIL_CLOSED.

preserve: all lifecycle observations including invalid/stale/contradictory records
reconstruction.projection_is_not_history: Current state is a derived view only. It never deletes, edits, supersedes or rewrites retained observations/receipts.
reconstruction.invalid_records: Records excluded from the valid lineage remain reconstructable with their validation failure reason.
reconstruction.manifest_rule: Every projection, including FAIL_CLOSED, is reconstructable through the separate authority-neutral reconstruction manifest; the manifest enumerates all admitted and rejected records and cannot create authority.
reconstruction.fail_closed_fidelity: FAIL_CLOSED reconstruction must preserve the exact validation gaps/contradictions that prevented a unique authentic frontier, not merely the final label.

ordering_boundary: Timestamps and deterministic tie-break metadata may order already-authenticated compatible records for reconstruction, but never establish authenticity, authority, predecessor validity or transition permission.
